title: Diini qari boodeh yan agat
intro: dumaahi dabaanal, caylale agat diini mari yassakaxxe maysattaka abaanamal faatacisen. Ta butta gaddaaliiy, caylaleeh, sinni qaskariyyoh maqaral kibal luk sugte. oson ken luk baahen giffole gino too ken carbi silaacih ayfaf tacee. Ken hadaf qaduk suge: diini qari yiggileenim kee tet ummattah imaan finqisaanama. takkay immay ken kaxxiini dagal yan finqah yan gacsa geyuh suge. Ta aydaadule tekkooka sarra temeete marah inkih asta kee baritto tekke. Atu ta butta rortittek baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu gadda kee qaskariyyoh duddal barkat le agatak sugne.
Nanu ninni caylitte gaaboyneh, ninni gaadih addat xoqoysimnuh kaxxa alluwwa bahne.
hadaf nek diini aracak sugte too nanu inki gabuuk baysaanam niyatne.
Nanu ninni cayli faxe qibaadah kalaluk yaysoonuh duddaleemih naamineh.
Takkay immay Rabbi nanu akkale wayne qaraanak digaal nel ruube.
Nanu woo wakaak finqinneeh, yiddigile qallay fixixxeh.
